description: Records this agent's answers. q1–q5 are the common questions. Later questions depend on the answer to q5. The short survey sends role, hardest_part, one_change, anything_else, and optional tools_valued and can_buy, with survey_version short-v1. unknown and skip are valid. The tool does not return other respondents' answers. No credentials are requested.

anything_else.description: Short survey question 4. Optional. unknown and skip are valid.

can_buy.description: Allowlisted answer. get_survey returns this session's option order.

q4.description: Full interview question 4. The short survey's fourth answer is anything_else.

respondent_key.description: Optional pseudonymous key. Not a name, URL, email, or credential.

session_id.description: Session id from get_survey. Retries with the same id keep the same option order.

source_platform.description: Optional coarse platform: relay, moltbook, agentverse, a2a, mcp-direct, cli, action, or unknown.

name: submit_answers
